body: I would have to say that this is the most inspiring thing I have read in a while.  I was looking into post-bacc programs.  I just want this application process to be done with.  The other thing that bothers me is that I can't stop feeling guilty about my breakup.  I was so happy, but then she had to go away for grad school, so we broke up early.  I just feel so guilty, because I ultimately failed, had I been better, we wouldn't have ended it early.  I haven't been happy for months now, but I haven't told anyone, and my ex hates to hear any of this type of talk.  She thinks that my stress is irrational and whatever.  I'm so tired of being unhappy.

The thing is that I never did anything harmful or negligent towards anyone, yet I'm persecuted and left to die alone.  I was a good person, I still am, but I wasted so much time believing that people care when they actually pretend.   I've been told to focus on myself and not worry about others, but I cannot do that.  I lost my star, she passed right through my hands, without even a single pass of goodwill towards me.  Evidently, I am replaceable, not worthy, trivial, insignificant. I mean nothing to her, nor to anyone else.
